brightness_qualification: physical approximation: bolometric and grey. It applies the D^4 specific-intensity transformation to a frequency-integrated flux, which is exact only for a source whose spectrum is unchanged in shape by the shift. It is NOT a photorealistic prediction and display exposure is applied separately.

destinations.solver_method: bracketed bisection on |x_star(t)| - D_flown(t), then secant refinement; bisection because the residual is monotone and bracketing cannot diverge

effective_metric: NONE. C1 is special-relativistic kinematics in flat spacetime. No warp metric, no propulsion energy, no collision hazard, no interstellar medium.
observer_frame: LocalShipFrame (instantaneous rest frame of the ship, boosted from BarycentricCartesian)
trajectory_model_purpose: accelerate at constant proper acceleration to the midpoint, then decelerate; arrives at rest
units: parsec; Julian year; parsec per Julian year
